params.name: language_hints_strict
params.doc: Restrict recognition to the hinted languages

params.name: enable_language_identification
params.doc: Tag tokens with the detected language

params.name: endpoint_sensitivity
params.doc: Endpoint eagerness; docs suggest 0.3 for voice agents

params.name: endpoint_latency_adjustment_level
params.doc: Latency/accuracy trade for endpoint detection (2 = voice-agent preset)

params.name: context
params.doc: Domain context: general text, terms, translation_terms (≤8k tokens)

params.name: client_reference_id
params.doc: Your correlation id, echoed in Soniox logs
